paraphrase: McTaggart's bundle on change does not hold: it is not the case both that no event changes in its A-series determinations while there are judgings and perceivings (STMT-MCTAGGART-NO-A-SERIES-CHANGE-BUT-APPEARS) and that all change is A-series change (STMT-MCTAGGART-ALL-CHANGE-IS-A-SERIES-CHANGE).
